mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We have overcast skies and 63 degrees at Verona Community Park, and the first quarter moon will be visible tonight along with an ISS pass starting at 8:27 PM; look for it rising in the northwest near Verona High School before it travels toward the northeast.

The Plan Commission is reviewing various development projects on October 5th, while the city continues to implement the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan to manage local growth and community resources.

Enjoy live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company today. Tomorrow, you can visit the Sugar River Fire and Smoke BBQ Festival in Paoli or head to the Capitol for the Dane County Farmers Market.
On September 5th, Verona police officers investigated a strange incident involving slices of cheese left on car windshields throughout several city streets.
Culver's is open until 10:30 PM today, though please note they are currently closed for a facility remodel, so no flavor of the day is being served.
